question: Which big New York factory and lab projects are still under construction or only proposed?
answer: Of the 156 sites on the New York map, 12 are under construction or commissioning, 3 have an award but no construction yet and 3 are only proposed or in permitting; the biggest by stated value are Micron White Pine campus (up to $100B), Project Double Reed ($19.46B), Chobani Rome megafactory ($1.2B).

items.title: Niagara Bottling / Adirondack Bottling Works

uncertain: The map keeps operating, building, pilot, awarded and proposed sites apart; an incentive, permit or power allocation is not production.

The editorial review counted 22 under-construction or proposed sites from the old map's filter; the registry has 18 with these three statuses (plus 9 research or pilot sites, not shown). The registry count is used here.
Target dates in the scale text (for example 2027 openings) are the companies' own targets.
